In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the sintering process of KNN piezoelectric ceramic is complex and difficult to control.
the composition,temperature and heating time are the key factors influencing the fabrication process of KNN piezoelectric ceramic.
KNN ceramics with high density,good sinterability and excellent piezoelectric properties could be obtained at the sintering temperature of 1050 ℃ for 4 h.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the sintering process of KNN ceramics can be optimized by adjusting the heating rate and holding temperature to improve the density,crystallinity and piezoelectric properties of ceramics.
the sintered density of KNN ceramics can be improved by optimizing the sintering conditions.

the sintering temperature of KNN should be controlled at 1080-1100 ℃,and the sintering time at 4-6 h.
